description: Turn deadlines that are inside their lead time into todos, one per deadline, and never twice (the deadline remembers its todo). Optional: user_id (whose list, defaults to the caller), due_within_days (default: each deadline's own lead time), contract_id. Returns what was created and what already had a todo.

due_within_days.description: Only deadlines due within this many days (default: each deadline's own lead time)

name: contract_deadlines_to_todos
